SELECTED_INDEX: 1
CONFIDENCE: 0.64
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very intense ring-breathing band at 1005 cm⁻¹ with companion bands at ~989 and ~1028 cm⁻¹, consistent with a monosubstituted phenyl ring. Strong aromatic C–H stretch at 3065 cm⁻¹ and ring C=C stretches at 1610/1586 cm⁻¹ support an aromatic system. Critically, the very strong 1256 cm⁻¹ band matches the characteristic asymmetric C–O–C stretch of an epoxide (oxirane), and the bands at 877 and 811 cm⁻¹ are in the expected region for epoxide ring modes. This pattern is well matched by styrene oxide (candidate 1). Sulfone candidates (4, 8, 9) would typically show two dominant S=O bands near ~1310 and ~1140 cm⁻¹, which is not observed here (those regions are weaker than 1256). The sulfoxide candidate (7) would place a strong S=O near ~1030 cm⁻¹ without explaining the very intense 1256 cm⁻¹ band pattern of an epoxide.
